name: Polyfork low-poly 3D catalogue
summary: 2,660 low-poly 3D models written as small programs: colours, proportions and parts are parameters you can tweak. Free tier covers every low-poly model; HD editions with PBR materials are paid.

access.price: Low poly free; HD with Pro $15/month or $100 lifetime
access.notes: No attribution. No resale or redistribution of the files; serving them to your own users needs a platform licence.

procedure: Open polyfork.dev/assets and filter by free
Download the GLB (Godot, Blender, glTF), FBX (Unity, Unreal) or USDZ, or import https://polyfork.dev/cdn/<id>.mjs in three.js
Agents: connect the MCP endpoint https://polyfork.dev/mcp, no key needed to browse

verdict.why: Free commercial use without attribution, parametric models and an MCP endpoint for agents.
